narr: Heavy rain produced multiple debris flows over CO-125 between mile markers 10 and 15 in the East Troublesome burn area. In addition, heavy rain produced localized flash flooding along Kinney Creek which impacted a nearby roads and adjacent properties in the Williams Fork burn area.
ev: Heavy rain produced multiple debris flows over CO-125 between mile markers 10 and 15. The road was closed and some travelers were stranded.
Heavy rain produced localized flash flooding.
lsr: MULTIPLE DEBRIS FLOWS OVER CO-125 BETWEEN MILE MARKERS 10 AND 15, ROAD CLOSED AND SOME TRAVELERS STRANDED.
